name: Confirm Placement Details
description: Agree tasks, dates, and hours with the studio; confirm your animation lead and pipeline access.
flavor: Clear briefs make clean animation.

name: Complete Animation Onboarding
description: Set up Maya/Blender, access the rig library, and review the studio's animation style guide.
flavor: Know the rig before you pose.

name: Animate a Shot or Cycle
description: Create polished animation: locomotion, combat, cinematics, or facial performance.
flavor: Animation is acting with a timeline.

name: Log Animation Hours & Reflection
description: Record hours and reflect on animation principles applied, feedback addressed, and iterations.
flavor: Every frame is a decision.

name: Animation Reflection
description: Write a reflection on your animation process: blocking, splining, polish, and lessons learned.
flavor: Reflection turns keyframes into craft.

name: Animation In-Game
description: Your animation is in a playable build. Document the shot and its context in gameplay.
flavor: Animation lives in the engine, not the viewport.

name: Measure Animation Impact
description: Explain how your animation improved readability, player feedback, or emotional resonance.
flavor: Good animation feels right. Great animation tells a story.

name: Book Studio Animation Visit
description: Arrange a visit to a studio's animation department. Confirm date, NDA, and pipeline tour.
flavor: See how pros bring characters to life.

name: Attend Animation Review
description: Sit in on a dailies session, animation review, or motion capture shoot.
flavor: Watch how leads direct performance.

name: Find Game Jam Animation Role
description: Join a game jam or student project as an animator. Confirm style, rigs, and scope.
flavor: Game jams are animation sprints.

name: Animate for a Game Jam
description: Create character animation, VFX animation, or UI motion for a 48-hour game jam.
flavor: Constraints breed expressive motion.

name: Game Jam Animation Feedback
description: Collect feedback from teammates and players on your animation's readability and feel.
flavor: Jam feedback is raw and honest.

name: Understand the Animation Brief
description: Clarify the brief: character, style reference, frame count, technical constraints, and deadline.
flavor: A brief understood saves re-animation.

name: Deliver Animation Shot
description: Produce the animation from blocking to final polish. Implement in-engine and iterate.
flavor: Blocking sells the idea. Polish sells the craft.

name: Document Animation Learnings
description: Write a post-mortem: workflow, technical challenges, and what you'd animate differently.
flavor: Every brief teaches a new constraint.

name: Partner Animation Requirements
description: Agree on animation deliverables with an industry partner: style, rig, format, and review process.
flavor: Partners want animation that works in their pipeline.

name: Complete Partner Animation
description: Deliver production-ready animation meeting the partner's technical and creative specs.
flavor: Professional dailies sharpen your eye.

name: Showcase Partner Animation
description: Present your partner work with context: brief, reference, workflow, and final result.
flavor: Show the process, not just the playblast.

name: Partner Animation Used
description: Your animation was integrated into the partner's project or influenced their style guide.
flavor: Shipped animation is the ultimate credit.

name: Agree Dates & Schedule
description: Confirm the schedule and hours in writing. Must fit college hours (8:30am–5:30pm, max 8hr day).
flavor: Verbal agreements evaporate. Written ones stick.

name: Agree Your Animation Role
description: Clarify responsibilities: gameplay, cinematics, facial, creatures, or technical animation.
flavor: Undefined animation work is rework waiting to happen.

name: Animation Lead Contact
description: Get a named animation lead and a way to reach them — email, Slack, or SyncSketch.
flavor: A lead's feedback is the best resource you'll have.

name: Find a Studio
description: Identify a studio whose animation style and pipeline match your strengths.
flavor: Animate for games you'd want to play.

name: Complete Animation Assignment
description: Finish a course assignment demonstrating animation principles relevant to your target role.
flavor: Grades open doors. Animation craft keeps them open.

name: Revise Animation After Notes
description: Improve a shot using specific dailies feedback. Shows adaptability and collaboration.
flavor: First pass blocks. Second pass performs.

name: Ask for an Animation Reference
description: Request written feedback from an animation lead or supervisor.
flavor: A reference is a vote of confidence in writing.

name: Write an Animation CV Bullet
description: Describe your animation contribution, the character/shot, and the player impact.
flavor: Don't list shots. List performance moments.

name: Daily Animation Log
description: Record what you animated, what feedback you addressed, and what you learned each day.
flavor: Animation unrecorded is progress unseen.

name: Animation Distinction Earned
description: Bonus evidence: your animation was recognised for excellence or creativity.
flavor: Excellence isn't accidental. It's animated with intent.

name: Save Animation Reel Piece
description: Keep a polished shot or sequence for your reel with breakdown: reference, blocking, final.
flavor: Your reel is your proof. Make every frame count.

name: Travel & Studio Access Plan
description: Check location, travel, workstation needs, and any studio access requirements.
flavor: The best plan fails if you can't reach the rig.

name: Wild Card: Animation Mentor
description: An animation mentor guides your shot. Use in place of any Setup, Action, or Proof card for a Live Project Brief.
flavor: The best animators had mentors first.

name: Wild Card: Careers Team
description: Careers team connects you with an animation placement. Use in place of any Setup, Action, or Proof card for a Block Placement.
flavor: They know which studios hire junior animators.

name: Wild Card: Dailies Review
description: A dailies session strengthens your evidence. Use in place of a Proof card for a Block Placement.
flavor: Fresh eyes see the pops you missed.

name: Wild Card: Extended Polish
description: Extra time to refine your animation. Use in place of an Action card for a Live Project Brief.
flavor: Great animation needs polish time.

name: Wild Card: Tutor Animation Review
description: A quick animation check-in with your tutor. Use in place of a Setup card for Volunteering.
flavor: Sometimes the right note changes the performance.
